## TRA Timeline

#### SPAC business combination and TRA execution

- 2017-07-07: Business combination closes between SPAC Conyers Park Acquisition and NCP-ATK Holdings (Atkins Nutritionals parent); Income Tax Receivable Agreement executed at 100% pass-through on the main attributes with a 75% AMT credit sub-rate
- 2017-07-13: Executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.6 to closing 8-K

#### Cash settlement and termination

- 2018-11-14: Standalone Termination Agreement executed; $26,468,000 cash Termination Payment to Continental Stock Transfer for pro rata distribution to former NCP-ATK stockholders and option holders, releasing all obligations
- 2018-11-16: Termination 8-K filed under Item 1.02

## Explanation

The Simply Good Foods Company executed an Income Tax Receivable Agreement on July 7, 2017 at the closing of its SPAC business combination between Conyers Park Acquisition Corp. and NCP-ATK Holdings (Atkins Nutritionals parent), with Roark Capital Acquisition acting as Stockholders' Representative for the former Atkins selling equityholders. The contract is an outlier in the TRA universe: rather than the modal 85% Up-C pass-through, it pays 100% of the Realized Tax Benefit on the main pre-closing tax attributes (NOLs, intangible-amortization basis from a 2003 acquisition, transaction tax deductions) and 75% on Excess AMT Credits capped at $7.6M, with an aggregate $100M cap on covered tax attributes. The TRA was terminated on November 14, 2018 via a standalone Termination Agreement settling all obligations for a $26.468M cash payment (~96.4% of the $27.468M booked carrying value), producing a $1.5M pre-tax gain. No amendments or restatements appear; subsequent M&A (Quest in 2019, OWYN in 2024) did not generate a new TRA. See `contract_log.md` for the operative payment-rate provisions and the termination instrument.
